name: Torch of the Dormant Flame
summary: The Torch of the Dormant Flame is a ritual implement carried by young Horde shaman during their communion with fire in Durotar. Awaiting the defeat of a flame manifestation atop the mountain, it serves as a vessel meant to capture primal elemental fire upon the Shrine of the Eternal Flame.

sections.title: Vessel of Awakening
sections.body: A shaman seeking the favor of fire is entrusted with the unlit Torch of the Dormant Flame before ascending the peaks above Durotar. After drinking a spirit-revealing fire sapta, the shaman sees and challenges a Minor Manifestation of Fire upon the mountaintop. Slaying this elemental spirit yields a glowing ember, which is deposited into the weathered brazier of the Shrine of the Eternal Flame. Touching the head of the dormant torch to the resulting white-hot conflagration awakens the wood, transforming it into a burning emblem of elemental mastery.

faq.q: What is the purpose of the Torch of the Dormant Flame?
aliases: why do i have this unlit torch
faq.answer: It is an unlit ceremonial torch given to shaman undertaking the Call of Fire trial. Once a manifestation of fire is defeated and its ember placed in the shrine's brazier, the torch is dipped into the white-hot flames to ignite it with elemental power.

faq.q: Where does this torch get lit?
aliases: where to light torch of dormant flame
faq.answer: It is ignited atop the mountain near Telf Joolam in Durotar, specifically at the brazier upon the Shrine of the Eternal Flame, immediately after defeating the Minor Manifestation of Fire.

aliases: who gives torch of dormant flame
faq.answer: The hermit shaman Telf Joolam grants the torch to initiates who have gathered the necessary ritual reagents to prepare the fire sapta.

angles.text: The dormant torch represents the initiate's unproven state; only by conquering a living manifestation of flame can a shaman kindle it and earn the right to summon a Fire Totem.
